title: 戴维宁等效的交流版：R_3 换成 L
statement: 和 World 2 的 `theorems-02-thevenin-basic` 同一个结构，只是 R_3 换成了电感 L，电源换成了正弦源；其余数值和直流题相同。
ω = 1000 rad/s，V̇_s = 12∠0° V（有效值），R_1 = 6 Ω，R_2 = 3 Ω，L = 8 mH，负载 R_L = 4 Ω 接在端子 a、b 之间。
求 a、b 左侧电路的戴维宁等效电路（开路电压 V̇_oc、等效阻抗 Z_eq），再求负载电流 İ_L。

questions.ask: 断开 R_L 后的开路电压 |V̇_oc| = ?
questions.explain: 开路时 L 中没有电流，L 上没有压降：V̇_oc 就是 R_2 上的电压，12 × 3/(6 + 3) = 4∠0° V，和直流题一样。
V̇_s 短路后 R_1 ∥ R_2 = 2 Ω，再串上 Z_L：Z_eq = 2 + j8 Ω。
虚部来自 Z_L = jωL = j8 Ω。直流题里这个位置是 R_3 = 2 Ω。

hints: 先拿掉 R_L 求开路电压：这时 L 中有没有电流？
求 Z_eq 时把 V̇_s 换成短路线，从 a、b 往左看：和直流一样化简串并联，只是 L 要写成 Z_L = jωL。
İ_L = V̇_oc/(Z_eq + R_L)：先把分母写成极坐标形式再除。
solution: **5. 和直流题对比。** 直流：v_oc = 4 V，R_eq = 4 Ω，i_L = 0.5 A。交流：V̇_oc 不变（开路时 L 和 R_3 一样没有电流），Z_eq 多了虚部 j8 Ω，所以电流变小，并且比电源电压落后 53.13°。

en.title: Thévenin equivalent, AC edition: R_3 becomes L
statement: Same structure as World 2's `theorems-02-thevenin-basic`; only R_3 has become an inductor L and the source is a sinusoid. All other values are the same as in the DC problem.
ω = 1000 rad/s, V̇_s = 12∠0° V (rms), R_1 = 6 Ω, R_2 = 3 Ω, L = 8 mH; the load R_L = 4 Ω is connected between terminals a and b.
Find the Thévenin equivalent of the circuit to the left of a, b (open-circuit voltage V̇_oc and equivalent impedance Z_eq), then the load current İ_L.

questions.explain: With the terminals open, no current flows in L, so there is no voltage across it: V̇_oc is the voltage across R_2, 12 × 3/(6 + 3) = 4∠0° V, the same as in the DC problem.
With V̇_s shorted, R_1 ∥ R_2 = 2 Ω, in series with Z_L: Z_eq = 2 + j8 Ω.
The imaginary part comes from Z_L = jωL = j8 Ω. In the DC problem this spot held R_3 = 2 Ω.
6 + j8 = 10∠53.13°; dividing by it subtracts 53.13°: İ_L = 0.4∠−53.13° A.

hints: Remove R_L first and find the open-circuit voltage: is there any current in L then?
For Z_eq, replace V̇_s with a short and look into a, b: reduce the series and parallel parts as in DC, writing L as Z_L = jωL.
İ_L = V̇_oc/(Z_eq + R_L): put the denominator in polar form first, then divide.
solution: **1. Impedance.** Z_L = jωL = j1000 × 0.008 = j8 Ω.
**2. Open-circuit voltage.** Remove R_L; no current flows in L, so there is no voltage across it: V̇_oc = V̇_s·R_2/(R_1 + R_2) = 12 × 3/9 = **4∠0° V**.
**3. Equivalent impedance.** Zero V̇_s (short): R_1 ∥ R_2 = 6 × 3/9 = 2 Ω, in series with Z_L: **Z_eq = 2 + j8 Ω**.

**5. Compared with DC.** DC: v_oc = 4 V, R_eq = 4 Ω, i_L = 0.5 A. AC: V̇_oc is unchanged (with the terminals open, L carries no current, just like R_3), Z_eq gains an imaginary part j8 Ω, so the current is smaller and lags the source voltage by 53.13°.
